characters.name: Bala Krishna
characters.description: Child Krishna, 5-6 heads, peacock feather in wild curls, golden pitambara, black Kali Kamli tied as wrestler's sash, cloud-dark blue skin, Srivatsa mark

characters.name: Kaliya
characters.description: Colossal obsidian many-hooded serpent, violet-green venom veins, fan of 7-9 visible hoods, never an exact count

environments.name: Kaliya-dah surface
environments.description: Poisoned river pool with lone Kadamba tree on black-sand bank, violet-green water, dead birds and cows, scorched earth

environments.name: Underwater cavern
environments.description: Dark blue-green water, rock formations, glowing Krishna silhouette, Naga-Patnis in mid-ground

props.name: Amrit Kalash
props.description: Golden pot of nectar, ornate, carried by Garuda, drops of amrit make the Kadamba immortal

props.name: Kanduk (cloth ball)
props.description: Golden yellow cloth ball, textured, used in the ball game, struck into the poisoned river

props.name: Kali Kamli (black blanket)
props.description: Black blanket tied as wrestler's sash around Krishna's waist, tightens when He slaps His arms
